issue.title: Agent Cleanup clan-member e2e tests fail since 04d35849d: panel_keys never reach [None, epic, review]
issue.description:
Found by the sase-14n.15 land agent. This epic did not cause it.

Both nodes in tests/ace/tui/test_agent_cleanup_panel_clan_members_e2e.py fail at master 1567269ca. They fail in isolation too, and in sase tool run check 49a0b5a3f03c73ae254e349f4616a50e:

    assert page.app._panel_group.panel_keys == [None, "epic", "review"]
    AssertionError: wait_for() timed out after 5.0s — predicate never returned True

Bisect: the file passes at 04d35849d^ and fails at 04d35849d ("feat(ace): agents-tab panel focus follows the selection on refresh", agent 0oq). The focus-follows-selection change most likely moves or regroups panels on refresh, so the expected panel keys never settle. The root cause has not been confirmed.

Nodes:
- tests/ace/tui/test_agent_cleanup_panel_clan_members_e2e.py::test_cleanup_panel_dismiss_completed_includes_clan_members
- tests/ace/tui/test_agent_cleanup_panel_clan_members_e2e.py::test_cleanup_panel_kill_and_dismiss_includes_clan_members

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails deterministically in isolation; bisected to 04d35849d, the file passes 2/2 at its parent and fails 2/2 at it

payload.entry: Backlog triage 2026-10-26 (sase 60832648be, sase-core 4121de03): verified FIXED. Both nodes in tests/ace/tui/test_agent_cleanup_panel_clan_members_e2e.py pass on HEAD (run together with the 16f node: 3 passed, -p no:randomly); Master Gate fast suite green at HEAD.
